title: Design: Notes tab shows the system note after Convert to No Charge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have an invoiced work order of the regular customer (it serves as the original work order), made for this test.
  • Have a new work order for the regular customer, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost, converted to No Charge with the category Warranty and the invoiced work order as Original work order, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow2-08-3d-notes-after-convert-to-no-charge.png, iwo-happy-24-24-notes-record-the-convert.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the no-charge work order.
  2. Click the Notes tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • A read-only note by ShopView, with the user and the time, reads "Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category Warranty, original work order [number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."
  • The work order number in the note is a link.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R18: “Every classification change writes a read-only system note on the work order (Notes tab, author ShopView, with the user and the time) and an Audit Log row: Convert to No Charge ("Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category [name], original work order [number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."), Change category (from, to, original work order kept or cleared), Convert to Billable ("Every line priced as a new line would be today. Category [name] removed."), Close (posting date, account), Reopen, and the line actions of Story 12 (S12-R6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
